from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareCountRecord(BaseModel):
    """Share/Unit outstanding count reported in a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or entity the filing belongs to")
    count_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the outstanding shares or units")
    instrument_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of instrument reported, e.g. 'shares', 'units', 'beneficial interest'")
    statement_label: str | None = Field(description="The text label describing the line item in the document")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the outstanding count is valid as of")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_count_records: list[ShareCountRecord]
